g.text: [not a JWT / bad signature / expired / no sub]
after the gate lets the request through, FastAPI checks
the query against the parameters of reports()
[date is not YYYY-MM-DD / limit is not an integer in 1-200]
"msg": "Input should be a valid date or datetime, invalid character in year",
[valid query (no date = every day, no tag = every tag, no limit = 20)]
reports JOIN sessions LEFT JOIN attachments
date = the day of reports.created_at in Thai time
tag = equal to one whole tag in reports.tags
link(attachment_id) turns each image into {attachment_id, url}
"desc": "The street floods every time it rains",
user_id = the bot's own user id, not the LINE ID
lat / lng = lat, lng of the location message the report points to, otherwise null
(location messages are inserted by no function -> 6-database)
